title: Product Backlog
description: Manage and prioritize your product backlog items

filter.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, description, or ID...
filter.noResults: No items match your search criteria.

createItem.title: Create Backlog Item
createItem.titlePlaceholder: Enter a clear, concise title for this backlog item
createItem.titleHelp: Provide a brief, descriptive title that summarizes what needs to be done. Example: "Implement user authentication with JWT tokens"
createItem.descriptionHelp: Explain the context, purpose, and any background information. Include user stories if applicable (e.g., "As a user, I want...")
createItem.moscowHelp: Must Have = Critical for success | Should Have = Important but not vital | Could Have = Nice to have | Won't Have = Future consideration
createItem.businessValueHelp: Quantify the business impact. Higher numbers indicate greater strategic importance and ROI potential.
createItem.storyPointsHelp: Estimate the relative effort using Fibonacci sequence. Consider complexity, uncertainty, and risk. Leave empty if not ready to estimate.
createItem.labelsPlaceholderEmpty: Type and press Enter to add labels...
createItem.labelsHelp: Press Enter to add a label. Use letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only. Maximum 10 labels, 30 characters each.
createItem.labelsMaxReached: Maximum 10 labels reached. Remove a label to add more.
createItem.acceptanceCriteriaPlaceholder: Define specific, testable conditions for completion...
createItem.acceptanceCriteriaHelp: List clear, measurable conditions that must be met. Use bullet points or numbered lists. Example: "1. User can log in with valid credentials 2. Invalid login shows error message 3. Session expires after 30 minutes"
createItem.capacityReached: This goal has reached its maximum capacity of {{maxLimit}} items.
createItem.capacityAvailable: This goal has {{currentCount}} of {{maxLimit}} items ({{availableSlots}} slot{{plural}} available).
createItem.unsavedMessage: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?

editItem.title: Edit Backlog Item
editItem.titlePlaceholder: Enter a clear, concise title for this backlog item (required)
editItem.titleHelp: Required: Provide a brief, descriptive title (5-200 characters) that clearly summarizes what needs to be done.
editItem.descriptionHelp: Required: Explain the context, purpose, implementation details, and any background information necessary for understanding this item.
editItem.moscowHelp: Required: Select one priority level. Must Have = Critical for success | Should Have = Important but not vital | Could Have = Nice to have | Won't Have = Future consideration
editItem.businessValueHelp: Required: Quantify the business impact. Higher numbers indicate greater strategic importance and ROI potential.
editItem.storyPointsHelp: Required: Estimate the relative effort using Fibonacci sequence. Consider complexity, uncertainty, and risk.
editItem.labelsPlaceholderEmpty: Type and press Enter to add labels... (required)
editItem.labelsHelp: Required: Add at least one label. Press Enter to add. Use letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only. Maximum 10 labels, 30 characters each.
editItem.labelsMaxReached: Maximum 10 labels reached. Remove a label to add more.
editItem.acceptanceCriteriaPlaceholder: Define specific, testable conditions for completion... (required)
editItem.acceptanceCriteriaHelp: Required: List clear, measurable conditions that must be met. Use bullet points or numbered lists for multiple criteria.
editItem.allFieldsRequiredDesc: Please complete all sections before saving
editItem.unsavedMessage: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?

productGoals.titleHelpPanelTip1: Be specific about what you want to achieve
productGoals.titleHelpPanelTip2: Start with a verb when possible (e.g., "Launch", "Improve", "Reduce")
productGoals.titleHelpPanelTip3: Keep it concise for quick scanning and reference
productGoals.titleHelpPanelTip4: Avoid vague terms like "better" or "more" - use specific outcomes
productGoals.titleHelpPanelGoodText: Launch mobile app v2.0 with offline sync capability
productGoals.descriptionHelpPanelTip1: Explain the problem you are solving or the opportunity you are addressing
productGoals.descriptionHelpPanelTip2: Describe who benefits from this goal and how
productGoals.descriptionHelpPanelTip3: Include context about why this goal matters now
productGoals.descriptionHelpPanelGoodText: Our users struggle with accessing data when offline. This goal addresses that by implementing local storage sync, improving user productivity by 40% in low-connectivity environments.
productGoals.descriptionHelpPanelAvoidText: We need to make the app better.
productGoals.successMetricsHelpPanelTip2: Include both quantitative and qualitative measures when applicable
productGoals.successMetricsHelpPanelTip3: Define metrics that directly indicate goal achievement
productGoals.successMetricsHelpPanelGoodText: Achieve 25% increase in mobile app daily active users; reduce offline data sync time to under 5 seconds; maintain 4.5+ star app store rating
productGoals.successMetricsHelpPanelAvoidText: Make users happy and improve performance
